data.title: 玛修 · 模拟战斗
data.description: 【玛修 · 模拟战斗】迦勒底模拟训练室的虚拟战场里，玛修举起圆桌型大盾挡在队友身前，装甲裙的菱形镂空处渗出微光，紫瞳燃着战意——「交给我吧，前辈的后背，由我来守护！」
data.action: 单膝稳住低位防御姿势，将大盾挡在训练队友身前
data.camera: full-body low-angle shot, shield bearer and protected teammate visible
data.promptProse: Mash lowers one knee and plants her cross-shaped shield against the training-grid floor, protecting a separate teammate standing behind in a plain practice uniform. Her armored dress, gloves and boots remain clear as she watches the simulated threat. The low full-body view includes the grounded shield and both figures. Blue holographic grid light defines floor perspective, while harmless energy arcs reflect along shield edges and armor, leaving darker chamber walls beyond.
